name: C4OPS
about: C4 smoke for the ops S1, S1L and C1 do not use: csv start/stop, random_walk (five modes, one diameter per segment, phases), hitch, gc, movie, soak (short, with its gc and final memory sample), save then load (the run loads its own folder: pass -ChimeraTerrainLoad=<this run's out dir>), and the collision ops that log skipped:C5. Not a gate; its results.json shows each op's record.
